NewName E2E Test Scenarios

This page provides test scenarios for validating NewName's download renaming capabilities according to the PRD specifications.

🏢 Business Documents

  • Biedronka Receipt
    Tests: Polish language, vendor extraction, VAT invoice recognition, amount parsing
  • Sprint Planning Meeting
    Tests: Company context, meeting type recognition, duration, business terminology

🎨 Design & Development

  • Figma Component Export
    Tests: Design tool recognition, component naming, UI context extraction

📸 Media & Content

  • Supabase Tutorial (Polish)
    Tests: Video classification, tech content, Polish language, duration/quality metadata
  • Landscape Photography
    Tests: Photo metadata, location extraction, Polish place names, nature subjects

📚 Academic & Research

  • arXiv Research Paper (Google)
    Tests: Academic content, author extraction, arXiv ID recognition, technical paper classification
  • AI Ethics Research Paper
    Tests: Academic content, author extraction, journal context, technical terminology

🧪 Test Coverage Matrix
